description: Find the sections of Pakistani laws relevant to a question: Pakistan Penal Code (PPC), Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), Code of Civil Procedure (CPC), the Constitution, Contract Act, Limitation Act, Qanun-e-Shahadat, family, tax, labour and provincial laws. Use for "punishment for snatching a motorcycle", "which section covers cheque dishonour", "bail in a non-bailable offence". Understands everyday words (murder finds qatl-i-amd, s.302 PPC). Returns section text with its citation.

act.description: Only search this act, e.g. "Code of Criminal Procedure".

query.description: The question or topic, or a section reference like "section 302 PPC".

name: search_statutes
title: Search Pakistani statutes
